MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  May 15, 2017

 A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
 called to order at 6:36 p.m. at Ernie Howlett Park, 25851 Hawthorne Blvd., Rolling Hills Estates,
 California, by CHAIR POPE.

 COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Chair Pope, Portugal, Retz, and Romanelli

 COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Giglia, Persichina, and Wroan

 STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

 PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, APRIL 17, 2017

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ

  TO APPROVE THE CORRECTED PARK & ACTIVITES MEETING MINUTES
  OF APRIL 17, 2017.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

 AUDIENCE ITEMS/WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON THE AGENDA

 None.

 CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  STREET TREE REMOVAL APPLICATION
  Director Clark provided the Park & Activities Commission with a brief summary of this
  request.

  Kim Erbe, Property Owner, made a request to remove a tree from the parkway in front of
  her home. Ms. Erbe provided invoices she paid to have her sewer line cleared of the
  street tree roots. Ms. Erbe stated that there is a second tree that she would like to remove
  on her property. Director Clark clarified that the tree on her private property does not
  require any permission from the City.

  COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE THE REMOVAL OF A EUCALYPTUS STREET TREE LOCATED IN
  FRONT OF 43 HIDDEN VALLEY ROAD TO BE REPLACED WITH A
  EUCALYPTUS OR CALIFORNIA PEPPER TREE STREET TREE AT THE COST
  OF THE APPLICANT.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

 BUSINESS ITEMS

 NONE

COMMISSION ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)
  1
A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORT

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI commended staff on replacing the wooden fencing with new vinyl
fencing.

B.  CITY CELEBRATION SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING UPDATE

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that he is pleased with collaboration with Betty’s Foundation.

Director Clark stated that he has found a juggler to replace the magic-show act for the event.

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that almost all sponsors are in place and one band is confirmed.
The expected number of bands is five.

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES
MAY 15, 2017
 COMMISSIONER POPE stated that the marketing plan for the event was very well done.

DIRECTOR CLARK stated that the buses for the Beer & Wine Festival were provided by
Supervisor Hahn’s and stated that he has submitted a request for buses to Supervisor Hahn’s
office as well.

There being no objection, CHAIR POPE ordered to receive and file these items.

DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

A.  PV STREET FAIR & MUSIC FESTIVAL BOOTH SIGN-UP SHEET, JUNE 10-11TH

Director Clark asked if the Commissioner’s would like to sign-up for the Peppertree Foundation
Booth at the PV Street Fair event.

TOUR OF ERNIE HOWLETT PARK

The Park & Activities Commission toured Ernie Howlett Park and observed the following list of
items that will need repair:

  •  Re-paint two (2) handicap parking spaces in main parking area in front of baseball field.
  •  Erosion in front of baseball field adjacent to (above mentioned) parking spaces.
  •  ADA compliant accessibility around snack shop.
  •  Log is rolled out in supplemental parking lot.
  •  Paint peeling on outside of equestrian restroom.
  •  Repair green strip on barn near the outside light.
  •  Concrete repair outside of women’s equestrian restroom.
  •  Gutter outside of barn needs to be repaired.
  •  Contact Bennett Landscaping to clear brush and dead trees.
  •  Concrete swell needs to be cleaned-out next to Arena #2.
  •  DG next to Arena #2
  •  Repair of rotting fence at Arena #2
  •  Two (2) carpet risers to be removed from Dressage Arena.
  •  Repair fence plank near Dressage Arena
  •  Clear weeds under grand stand at Dressage Arena.
  •  Paint basketball restroom.

ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR POPE moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  ADJOURN THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE adjourned the meeting at 7:27 p.m. to the
Adjourned Park & Activities Commission Meeting of June 19, 2017 at 6:00 p.m. at George F
Canyon Nature Center, 27305 Palos Verdes Drive East, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.

 Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

 __________________________  _________________________
 Carol Corea  Douglas R. Prichard  2
 Minutes Secretary  City Clerk

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
MINUTES
MAY 15, 2017
